default/32014.htm.text: Ivan: The boy in shabby clothing looks very anxious. He appears to have slept outdoors in this dangerous place.

Q00651_RunawayYouth/32014-01.htm.text: Ivan: Oh, you're an adventurer, aren't you? Phew... I'm Ivan. I'm a fisherman like my father! But to tell you the truth, I hate the smell of fish! So I left home... I've been wandering around this dangerous place, and now I'm thinking that maybe my father was right after all! I wish I could go back…

links.text: "Get lost! I've got my own problems."

Q00651_RunawayYouth/32014-01a.htm.text: Ivan: The boy appears not to trust you. He doesn't want to talk to you. (Only characters level 26 and above are permitted to take on this quest.)

Q00651_RunawayYouth/32014-02.html.text: Ivan: Thanks to you, I can get home safely. Thank you again! My father is Batidae, a Fishing Guild Member of the Town of Schuttgart . If you go there, please look for my father. He'll reward you. I'm leaving now... Good luck!

Q00651_RunawayYouth/32014-03.html.text: Ivan: You're such a cold person... I never should've left home.... If I die out here, I will curse you and haunt you forever!

Q00651_RunawayYouth/32014-04.htm.text: Ivan: Thank you so much! Now I can now get home safely. Again, thank you. My father is Batidae, a Fishing Guild Member of the Town of Schuttgart . If you go there, please look for my father. He'll reward you. I'm leaving now... Good luck!

Q00651_RunawayYouth/32014-05.htm.text: Ivan: You don't have the Scroll of Escape... If you ever meet someone who has one, please ask them to help me! By all that is Holy, I beg you!
